translated: The Jizera mountain beech is a national nature reserve, which was created on 16 August 1999 by the merger of the original seven national nature reserves Špičák, Slouvá vrch, Míledník, Štolpichy, Tistina, Frýdlantský cimmburi and Paličík by Decree No. 200 / 1999.
